description: Fetch a page or API response from any website that charges AI agents with HTTP 402 (x402 pay-per-crawl), paid from your prepaid AIPayGen credit: no wallet needed. You set max_price_usd; you're charged the site's price plus 15%, plus this $0.001 fee. Free pages are returned for just the fee. If a site collects the payment but doesn't return the page, the site's price can't be refunded: only buy from sites you trust. If the site never collects it, your credit is returned once the payment has expired (checked hourly). Needs an API key with credit. Costs $0.001 per call.

max_price_usd.description: Most you'll pay the site for this page (default 0.05, at most 1). Our 15% fee is on top.

url.description: https URL of the page or API to buy, e.g. https://example.com/article

name: paid_fetch
title: Buy a page from an x402 site
